Container.Name: PI
Container.Overview: pi coding agent (earendil-works/pi) merged with the PI WEB browser client (jmfederico/pi-web) in one container: chat, file diffs, git worktrees, and real interactive terminals in the browser, with a session daemon so agent runs survive closing the tab. Image is built and version-tracked automatically at github.com/nphil/pi: a scheduled workflow watches npm for new pi/pi-web releases, bumps versions.json, and pushes a fresh :latest to GHCR, so this app simply shows an update in the Docker tab when upstream releases; Apply Update recreates from this template. Runs as nobody:users with a single /data mount (pi state, pi-web state, config, and the agent workspace) so the container plus the non-root user is the sandbox. Internal only: LAN and tailnet, never exposed publicly. Models come from llama-swap at :9292; the declared contextWindow values in /data/pi-agent/models.json must track the -c values in llama-swap's config.
Container.Requires: llama-swap up on :9292 for models. This template is the canonical container definition; Apply Update recreates from it.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: PI WEB has no built-in auth: keep this LAN/tailnet internal, never forwarded or proxied publicly.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything: pi state (pi-agent/), pi-web state (pi-web/), config (config/), home (home/), and the agent workspace (workspace/)
